user.title: Sign in to MakerWorld
user.description: Enter the email address associated with your Bambu Lab account. Bambu Lab will send a one-time verification code. Only global accounts on api.bambulab.com are currently supported.

code.title: Enter verification code
code.description: Enter the code from the Bambu Lab email. To request another code, select the checkbox. Home Assistant stores the resulting access token in its local configuration.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to complete the Bambu Lab request: {detail}
error.invalid_code: The code is invalid or has expired. Check the code or request a new one.

abort.already_configured: This MakerWorld account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same Bambu Lab account used for this integration.

init.title: Select sensor groups
init.description: Select which calculated reward sensors to enable. Gift card values are estimates based on the selected store terms; USD cash rewards use exclusive points and a USD 100 minimum payout threshold. The selection also controls the corresponding 7-, 14-, and 30-day estimates. Disabled groups are removed from the entity registry, so dashboards and automations referencing them may need updating. Account and raw point sensors remain available.

shop.title: Configure gift card estimates
shop.description: Select the Bambu Lab store region and the points to include in the estimate. The combined basis uses regular and exclusive points for gift cards; USD cash rewards always use exclusive points. The EU offer of EUR 40 for 524 points was verified by the project author on 10 November 2026. Other regional presets are experimental.

terms.title: Review gift card terms
terms.description: Check the current offer in your own Bambu Lab point store. The EU example is EUR 40 for 524 points. Use a period as the decimal separator. Partial values are estimates; whole gift cards are counted by rounding down. This integration does not verify redemption eligibility or store availability.

error.invalid_currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, such as EUR or USD.
error.invalid_amount: Enter a number from 0.000001 to 1000000000000 using a period as the decimal separator.
